bug_summary: to-json-schema 変換器の min_value/max_value アクションが type:'integer' のスキーマを number としか認識せず、integer + minValue/maxValue の組み合わせで誤って変換エラーになっていた
pr_title: Narrow min_value/max_value support to number schemas
pr_description: The min_value and max_value converters accepted both number and integer JSON schema types. This narrows the type guard to number only, keeping the two range actions consistent with how the rest of convertAction treats numeric schemas.
